ghostv2.note: Ghostv2 consumes wire-contract.v1.schema.json and shared fixtures with ajv; it must not maintain a divergent handwritten copy.

notes: This directory is the single canonical, versioned source of the Shared Investigations collaboration wire contract.
Both repositories validate the SAME fixtures against this schema rather than keeping divergent handwritten meanings.
Fixtures contain only synthetic values. No real organization endpoints, group object identifiers, tokens, PEMs, or secrets appear here.
Bumping the wire contract requires a new schemaVersion and preserving legacy fixtures so supported legacy clients keep validating.
